The '''energy pike''' was a two [[Meter/Legends|meter]] long [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] with a blade at one end. It had an energy sheath and the blade vibrated during combat. The energy pike was the traditional weapon wielded by [[S'krrr (species)|S'krrr]] warriors.
